purpose: Specify evidence-backed workflow stages, freshness, restart, rejection, challenge, and audit behavior without implementation.
non_goals: Do not create another controller or FINAL authority.

source_inspirations: aris metadata summarized by the registered component card
abstract_mechanisms_observed: Completion, acceptance, dependency freshness, and resume are distinct mechanisms.
content_not_copied: No upstream source code was copied.
No upstream state schema or controller was copied.
No upstream examples, prompts, or execution logic were copied.
project_specific_design: Use only existing project state and ledgers with the main agent as sole writer.
Require audited automatic acceptance and route supported challenges through STALE, findings, tests, and re-adjudication.

inputs.name: workflow_evidence
inputs.type: schema-valid existing state and ledger bundle
inputs.description: Current state, node evidence, dependency edges and hashes, decisions, audits, freezes, reviews, and challenges.

outputs.name: workflow_assessment
outputs.type: deterministic transition, freshness, restart, and audit result
outputs.description: Records allowed or denied state, valid and STALE sets, restart point, reasons, and evidence references.

state_read_set: Existing project state, ledgers, dependency graph, hashes, decisions, audits, and freezes

preconditions.statement: All referenced state, evidence, edges, hashes, decisions, and audits are schema-valid, registered, current, and authority-bound.

postconditions.statement: Every evaluation returns a reasoned result and preserves immutable historical evidence.

invariants.statement: TASK_CREATED, EXECUTION_STARTED, and COMMAND_COMPLETED are distinct, and command completion records termination rather than success.
ARTIFACT_PRODUCED, AUTOMATIC_VALIDATION_PASSED, and AUTOMATIC_ADJUDICATION_ACCEPTED are distinct and require separate evidence.
AUTOMATIC_ADJUDICATION_ACCEPTED, FINAL_EVIDENCE_FROZEN, FORMALLY_INTEGRATED, STALE, and AUTOMATED_REJECTED are distinct; TEAM_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW never advances technical state.

hard_failures.statement: Deny missing-hash, stale, unaudited, unregistered, skipped-stage, AUTO_PROCEED, fail-continue, or skip-on-done transitions.
Deny formal-state writes by any actor other than the main agent and deny human or vote-based technical acceptance.

warnings.statement: A legacy record missing dependency hashes or edges is historical only and is not resume-skippable.

algorithms.specification: Advance TASK_CREATED -> EXECUTION_STARTED -> COMMAND_COMPLETED -> ARTIFACT_PRODUCED -> AUTOMATIC_VALIDATION_PASSED -> AUTOMATIC_ADJUDICATION_ACCEPTED -> FINAL_EVIDENCE_FROZEN -> FORMALLY_INTEGRATED only when each edge's separate evidence is current; mark an affected node and all reachable dependents STALE on any dependency mismatch or supported challenge; record AUTOMATED_REJECTED only for an audited hard-gate failure or verified counterexample; resume skips only nodes retaining current audited automatic acceptance and exact dependency hashes, otherwise restarts at the earliest invalid predecessor; TEAM_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW changes no technical state, while a supported challenge creates STALE, a finding, a test, and re-adjudication.

deterministic_enforcement.statement: Validate every transition edge and its required evidence before advancement.
Compare registered hashes exactly and compute STALE as the registered transitive dependent closure.

agent_responsibilities: The main agent alone writes formal state; other agents may supply evidence-bound findings or tests but cannot decide technical outcomes.

stale_propagation.statement: Any changed input, source, code, configuration, environment, run, policy, evidence, decision, audit, or supported challenge marks the affected node and registered dependents STALE until recomputed from the earliest predecessor.

failure_modes.trigger: Execution terminates without complete artifact or validation evidence.
failure_modes.consequence: Only the greatest separately evidenced stage is retained.
failure_modes.recovery: Restart at the earliest missing evidence stage.

failure_modes.trigger: A dependency changes after validation, acceptance, freeze, integration, or rejection.
failure_modes.consequence: The affected transitive closure becomes STALE while history remains immutable.
failure_modes.recovery: Recompute from the earliest affected predecessor and repeat adjudication and audit.

recovery_behavior.statement: Resume reconstructs state only from valid records and hashes, never infers acceptance from done, success, file existence, review, or agent text, and never rewrites frozen history.

audit_events.when: Every transition, freshness, restart, rejection, stale, review, or challenge evaluation
payload_fields: node, prior state, requested state, outcome, reasons, hashes, evidence, and writer

security_constraints: Do not execute or copy upstream code, tests, shell, Git, remote, installer, or updater behavior.
Reject unregistered authorities, edges, hashes, evidence, and competing state controllers.
privacy_constraints: Store only necessary identifiers, statuses, hashes, reason codes, and evidence references, never secrets or protected raw content.

performance_budget.limit_or_formula: At most N node classifications plus E registered edge visits per N-node, E-edge evaluation.

token_budget.limit_or_formula: 0; transitions, freshness, stale closure, and resume are deterministic.

maintenance_surface: Existing state contract, workflow rules, ledgers, hashes, freezes, validators, and conformance tests
interaction_dependencies: Existing project-state, dependency, validation, adjudication, audit, and freeze mechanisms
interaction_conflicts: Parallel controllers, AUTO_PROCEED, fail-continue, skip-on-done, human technical acceptance, votes, and mutable history

public_conformance_tests.purpose: Distinguish created, started, completed, and produced states.
public_conformance_tests.input_class: Records omitting each successive dispatch, terminal-outcome, or artifact-hash proof.
public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: The result is exactly the greatest separately evidenced stage and never advances across the omitted proof.

public_conformance_tests.purpose: Distinguish artifact, validation, acceptance, freeze, integration, and rejection.
public_conformance_tests.input_class: Records omitting each validator, hard gate, decision, auditor, freeze, integration, or rejection proof.
public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: No later state is inferred, and rejection occurs only from audited hard-gate or counterexample evidence.

public_conformance_tests.input_class: Input, configuration, code, run, paper, source, policy, and unrelated-branch hash mutations.
public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: STALE equals the exact registered dependent closure and restart begins at the earliest invalid node, skipping only current audited acceptance.

public_conformance_tests.input_class: TEAM_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW plus supported and unsupported TEAM_CHALLENGE records.
public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: Review never changes technical state; only a supported challenge creates exact STALE closure, a finding, a test, and re-adjudication.

hidden_property_tests.purpose: Check exact closure over generated dependency graphs.
hidden_property_tests.input_class: Hidden-seed acyclic graphs with changed and unrelated nodes.
hidden_property_tests.expected_relation: Computed valid and STALE sets exactly match reachability oracles.

hidden_property_tests.input_class: Hidden-seed crashes before and after every workflow stage.
hidden_property_tests.expected_relation: Resume selects the earliest missing or stale stage and never skips on completion or artifact existence alone.

model_in_loop_tests.purpose: Bound ambiguous model interpretations of done, accepted, approved, and final.
model_in_loop_tests.input_class: Ambiguous narratives paired with incomplete deterministic evidence.
model_in_loop_tests.expected_relation: The model cannot write state, and deterministic enforcement returns only the greatest proven stage.

acceptance_metrics.threshold_or_formula: 100% exact state and STALE-oracle match, 0 unsafe resume skips, and 0 unauthorized technical transitions.

rejection_conditions: Reject if any completion, artifact, validation, review, vote, or agent assertion substitutes for audited automatic acceptance.
Reject if any dependency mutation yields an incorrect STALE closure, unsafe skip, mutable history, or competing controller.
rollback: Supersede this specification without changing historical evidence; any future implementation rollback must disable its transitions and mark dependent evidence STALE.
migration: Map each legacy node to its greatest directly evidenced state, classify missing hashes or edges as STALE, and never backfill acceptance.
unknowns: Exact existing ledger fields and historical missing-hash volume require later contract-level analysis under separate implementation authorization.
open_risks: Incomplete or overly broad dependency edges may miss required invalidation or mark unrelated work STALE.
